text: Singer, musician, and Grammy-winning music producer Shooter Jennings is keeping alive the legacy of his late father, country star Waylon Jennings, by producing long-lost material that he found stashed away. Hear music from the upcoming album "Diamonds."
translated_text: 歌手、音乐家和格莱美获奖音乐制作人射手詹宁斯 (Shooter Jennings) 通过制作他发现的藏匿已久的材料，延续了他已故父亲、乡村明星韦伦·詹宁斯 (Waylon Jennings) 的遗产。聆听即将推出的专辑“Diamonds”中的音乐。

text: The 26th president is finally getting his own presidential library amid the prairie grass of North Dakota. Take a tour of what is described as an immersive experience of Roosevelt's life and legacy, as well as the nature that shaped him and his vision of America.
translated_text: 第 26 任总统终于在北达科他州的草原上拥有了自己的总统图书馆。参观被称为罗斯福一生和遗产的身临其境的体验，以及塑造他和他对美国的愿景的大自然。
